code:
cause_notes   the story so far — tested, ruled out, emerging pattern
fix_notes     the answer — the permanent fix, once deployed
root_cause    reference field -> cmdb_ci or category (reportable)
caption: A reader should never dig through dead ends to find the fix.

eyebrow: Why root_cause is a reference, not free text
code:
Free text:  "the database server" (not reportable, inconsistent)
Reference:  root_cause -> cmdb_ci: PROD-DB-07
  -> "which CI caused the most Problems this year?" is now a report
caption: Structured data, not a sentence buried in notes.

steps.label: Root Cause Analysis
steps.sub: often the longest-lived state, while cause_notes builds up

steps.label: Fix in Progress
steps.sub: cause is known, permanent fix is being built or scheduled

steps.label: Resolved / Closed
steps.sub: fix deployed, then closed after a review period

code:
Incident:  New -> In Progress -> Resolved -> Closed   (fast)
Problem:   New -> Root Cause Analysis -> Fix in Progress
           -> Resolved -> Closed                       (deep)
caption: A slow Problem next to fast Incidents is both processes working correctly.

subtitle: Cause identified, fix not yet deployed — what happens next.
